answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 50839 Country: India Title: Seeing the dead body of Male Question: Is it prohibited to see the dead body of deceased male after janazah salah? Answer ID: 50839 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 358/279/D=03/1435) It is lawful, but it is makrooh after burial. ولا باس بان يرفع ستر الميت ليرى وجهه وانما يكره بعد الدفن عالمگیري کتاب الکراہة ج 5، ص 406 Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
